title: Steeper 30–50 Hz iEEG spectra in ictal than interictal excerpts in eight HUP participants are frequency-band sensitive
abstract: In eight convenience-selected participants from OpenNeuro ds004100 v1.1.3, participant-median 30–50 Hz log-log PSD slopes were steeper in one ictal than one interictal excerpt for all eight pairs (median delta +1.020; exact Wilcoxon p=0.0078125). Adjacent-band checks failed, so the finding is a narrow exploratory description rather than a broadband aperiodic, E:I, or clinical biomarker claim.
